hero.h1: The whole cottage for your family, near the waterfalls
faq.a1: For families with children, couples, hikers and groups of friends. You rent the whole cottage – there is only ever one group of guests – and we are open all year round.
faq.q2: How many people can stay and what are the bedrooms like?
faq.a2: The cottage has 10 beds, 2 Montessori-style children’s beds with rails (200 × 90 and 140 × 70) and 2 baby cots. On the ground floor there is a bedroom with a double bed and the children’s room right next to it, connected as walk-through rooms. In the attic there are two separate bedrooms, each with a double bed and two single beds.
faq.q3: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a3: Check-in is from 15:00 to 23:59, check-out from 7:00 to 10:00. Check-in is self-service, so you can arrive whenever suits you within that window. Early check-in or late check-out is possible for a fee of €60. We don’t live in the cottage during your stay, so you have it all to yourselves.
faq.q4: Is the hot tub included in the price?
faq.a4: Yes, the outdoor hot tub is included in the price of your stay.
faq.a5: The fully equipped kitchen has an electric oven, a ceramic hob, a fridge with freezer, a kettle and a coffee maker, plus a dining table for everyone.
faq.q6: What is the bathroom like, and is there Wi-Fi?
faq.a6: The bathroom has a bathtub, washbasin, washing machine and dryer, and towels are provided. The toilet is separate, and there is a second toilet with a washbasin in the attic. Wi-Fi works throughout the house.
faq.a7: A kids’ corner with books and toys, a playground with a playhouse, a sandpit, a climbing frame and a swing, and a paddling pool in summer. For the little ones there are 2 baby cots and 2 beds with rails, a high chair, a changing table and a potty.
faq.q8: What is outside in the yard?
faq.a8: A covered terrace for morning coffee or an evening barbecue, a garden swing and room for badminton. The grill, the fire pit and a cauldron for goulash are yours to use, and firewood is ready for you. Please bring your own charcoal or grill briquettes.
faq.q9: Is the cottage warm in winter?
faq.a9: Yes. The house has underfloor heating and a fireplace in the living room – perfect for the coldest evenings.
faq.q10: Is there parking at the house?
faq.a10: Yes, free parking right at the house. The bus stop is about 100 m away, the train station 5.5 km.
faq.q11: Where can we shop and eat out?
faq.a11: A grocery shop and a restaurant are about 5 km from the cottage (4.7 and 4.8 km). We recommend doing a bigger shop on the way.
faq.q12: What is there to do nearby?
faq.a12: Straight from the house, without a car, you can walk to the Háj waterfalls, along the Angel Road to the angel statue (a prop from the film Behind Enemy Lines), up to Turňa Castle and into the Zádiel valley. By bike you can ride to Hačava. By car you can reach the Hrhov waterfall, the Hrhov and Perín fishponds, the Granárium, the Hussite church in Lúčka, the plant church in Debraď and the Jasov cave. In winter the Štós – Šikmá stráň ski resort, cross-country ski trails and thermal pools are close by.
faq.a13: The minimum stay is 2 nights. Unfortunately pets are not allowed, and smoking is not permitted indoors. The cottage is not wheelchair accessible.
faq.a14: Through Booking.com, Megaubytovanie or Airbnb, whichever you use. Feel free to message us directly with any questions.
